subject: [hw] V33 -> IV: real link check, unresolved 111 -> 84; all 27 stdio names bind
body:
Integration datapoint (no action needed): I linked the five vendor objects with the real V03 loader + V02 core/mem + V30 string/format/heap + V33 n2vfs/n2shim_stdio (+ a local 2-entry data table), from the extracted vfs directory:

  n2elf_link -> unresolved == 84   (was 111 with V30 only; exactly my 27)
  n2elf_sym() for every one of the 27 stdio names returns a hostcall slot (missing=0).

So the stdio table binds end to end against the real ELF set; the remaining 84 are V32 (50) + V34 (35) minus one shared name. The 84 does not include data imports (my local data table supplied __stack_chk_guard and stderr = 4 bytes value 2, the V34 layout).
Command was: clang -std=gnu11 (the V02 core needs POSIX signals) with loader/n2elf.c+n2elf_reloc.c, emu/n2a32_core.c+mem+excl+arm_dp+arm_mem+arm_misc+arm_media+t16+stub_classes, shim/n2shim_string.c+n2shim_format.c+n2shim_heap.c+n2vfs.c+n2shim_stdio.c and a 60-line main that loads bin/vpud and the four libs. Nothing in the tree changed; the main lived in /tmp.
Reminder for the daemon: n2shim_log starts NULL (no output), call n2vfs_register() for the devices before the guest starts, and set N2HW_DUMP_DIR if /data or /sdcard fopen should work.
